entry.sourceResolution: SetFilterSourceOperation.GetOutputInfo resolves selected output, binding index and global-variable flag

entry.input: SetFeatureRelatedIOOperation receives NameValueItem, filterString and feature mapping metadata
entry.commit: sets RelateIO/RelateIndex/Value, clears feature value store, updates parent property, calls Group/Procedure SetIoParams
